description: This header file defines function declarations for parsing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and converting IPv6 addresses to string format in the lighttpd project.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 string into numerical IP and optional netmask and port.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv6
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 string into numerical address, network, and optional port.

methods.name: li_ipv6_tostring
methods.description: Converts a 16-byte IPv6 address into a string representation.
